sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:253

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:253:1
items.html: Since AA and Atzilut were blocked, it caused a diminution to the Nukva of ZA of Atzilut; all nine upper Sefirot would depart from her. And there remained in her only one point alone. For the Nukva has no existence of any building except through the Mochin of the Mazal, for ZA does not begin to build her before he attains the discernment of Neshama, which is received in two bendings of the head, from the Mochin of AB of the Mazal that come out in Atik, as above in the adjacent item. And if so, after the Mochin of the Mazal were blocked, for AVI returned to the discernment of the Mochin of SAG, all her nine first ones, which are received from AB of the Mazal, flew away from the Nukva, and she remained only in the point of the anterior vessels, which is the discernment of the Keter of vessels and the discernment of the Malchut of lights.
